rows.quote: Naga Siren and her illusions deal bonus damage to enemies and reduce their armor for %duration% seconds every %hits% attacks.
rows.reason_zh: 此次只调整减甲数值，说明未写明一次触发会伤害多个敌人，原范围伤害否定行可沿用。
四个等级的护甲修正仍为负值，均能降低目标护甲。

rows.quote: deal bonus damage to enemies and reduce their armor for %duration% seconds every %hits% attacks
rows.reason_zh: 普通攻击达到指定次数后仍会触发额外伤害和减甲。
唯一改动是减甲数值，决定可被破坏性的 IsBreakable 字段没有变更，原判定沿用。

rows.quote: Using Rip Tide doesn't interrupt channeling.
rows.reason_zh: 说明仍写明使用激流不会打断持续施法，也未加入打断目标持续施法的效果。

rows.quote: Once it arrives to the location, the Death Pulse spreads towards nearby enemies and allies.
rows.reason_zh: 死亡脉冲到达后仍向周围敌人扩散，冷却从19秒增至20秒不影响原魔晶范围伤害判定。

rows.quote: Once it arrives to the location, the Death Pulse spreads towards nearby enemies and allies.
rows.reason_zh: 死亡脉冲到达后仍向附近友军扩散，此次仅调整冷却，原魔晶治疗判定沿用。

rows.quote: Necrophos turns into a large Death Pulse towards the target unit's position.
rows.reason_zh: 瘟疫法师本人仍化为死亡脉冲并移向目标单位的位置。

rows.quote: Does not trigger spell reflect.
rows.reason_zh: 说明仍写明该技能不会触发技能反弹，也未赋予它反弹指向技能的能力。

rows.quote: AbilityCooldown.base: [19]→[20]
rows.reason_zh: 两版对移动方式的描述相同，唯一改动是冷却，原魔晶地形通行判定沿用。

rows.quote: towards the target unit's position
rows.reason_zh: 技能仍以选定单位的位置为目的地，此次改动未涉及可选目标。

rows.quote: causing nearby enemy units to lose a percentage of their max health over time
rows.reason_zh: 基础光环仍能使周围多个敌方单位持续损失生命。

rows.quote: Heartstopper Aura's Health Decay is increased by %heal_regen_to_damage%%% of Necrophos's current health regeneration.
rows.reason_zh: A杖只提高已有光环的生命流失量，光环本身由基础技能提供。

rows.quote: Necrophos stills the hearts of his opponents, causing nearby enemy units to lose a percentage of their max health over time.
rows.reason_zh: 基础效果仍以瘟疫法师为中心，持续影响周围敌方单位。

rows.quote: heal_regen_to_damage.scepter: [50]→[45]
rows.reason_zh: 改动仅降低A杖的回复转伤害系数，IsBreakable 字段没有变更，原基础判定沿用。

rows.quote: Heartstopper Aura's Health Decay is increased by %heal_regen_to_damage%%% of Necrophos's current health regeneration.
rows.reason_zh: A杖读取瘟疫法师当前的生命恢复来提高敌人的生命流失量，没有施加治疗。

rows.quote: causing nearby enemy units to lose a percentage of their max health over time
rows.reason_zh: 基础效果仍是使附近敌人持续损失生命，没有使施法者主动位移。

rows.quote: Break disables the gaining of new stacks.
rows.reason_zh: 破坏仍会阻止获得新层数，已有层数的加成仍然生效。

rows.quote: regen.base: [3.8]→[3.3]
rows.reason_zh: 每层回复量降至3.3，击杀获得的叠层仍提供生命恢复。

rows.quote: Shadow Fiend's presence reduces the armor and magic resistance of nearby enemies.
rows.reason_zh: 新版仍明确降低周围敌人的护甲。

rows.quote: Shadow Fiend's presence reduces the armor and magic resistance of nearby enemies.
rows.reason_zh: 光环仍以影魔为中心，持续影响周围敌人。

rows.quote: presence_magic_resistance_reduction.base: null→[-4,-6,-8,-10]
rows.reason_zh: 新增字段控制减魔抗，IsBreakable 字段没有变更，原可被破坏判定沿用。

new_mechanisms.quote: Shadow Fiend's presence reduces the armor and magic resistance of nearby enemies.
new_mechanisms.reason_zh: 7.42在基础光环中新增了对周围敌人的魔法抗性削减。

rows.quote: Shadow Fiend gains Bonus Movement and Attack Speed for %duration% seconds.
rows.reason_zh: 技能持续期间仍提高影魔自身的移动速度。

rows.quote: Units near Shadow Fiend when the souls are released can be damaged by several lines of energy.
rows.reason_zh: 一次释放的能量线仍可伤害影魔附近的多个单位。

rows.quote: Any unit damaged by Requiem of Souls will be feared and have its movement speed reduced for %requiem_fear_duration% seconds, increased by %requiem_duration_per_soul% seconds for each additional soul that hits it.
rows.reason_zh: 主动释放仍造成恐惧，持续时间改为基础时长加额外灵魂命中的延长量，死亡释放仍不施加恐惧。

rows.quote: The wave back to Shadow Fiend heals him for all the damage it dealt.
rows.reason_zh: A杖回程波仍会恢复影魔自身的生命。

rows.quote: The wave back to Shadow Fiend heals him for all the damage it dealt.
rows.reason_zh: 回复量仍等于A杖回程波造成的全部伤害，符合按技能伤害吸血的定义。

rows.quote: requiem_reduction_mres.base: [-5,-10,-15]→null
rows.reason_zh: 减魔抗字段已删除，7.42的命中说明也删去了降低魔法抗性的效果。

rows.quote: Fear and movement slow do not apply if the Requiem was released on death.
rows.reason_zh: 主动释放命中时仍降低移动速度，死亡释放仍不施加减速。

rows.quote: dealing damage to enemy units in the area
rows.reason_zh: 一次施放仍会对作用区域内的多个敌方单位造成伤害。

rows.quote: Cooldown reduced by %cooldown_reduction_on_hero_hit%s per enemy hero hit.
rows.reason_zh: 魔晶命中英雄时仅缩短毁灭阴影自身的冷却，未缩短其他技能或物品的冷却。

rows.quote: causes the enemy to take bonus Shadowraze damage per stack
rows.reason_zh: 每层只增加目标受到的毁灭阴影伤害，未赋予物理伤害或全部伤害加深。

rows.quote: Adds a stacking damage amplifier on the target that causes the enemy to take bonus Shadowraze damage per stack.
rows.reason_zh: 各级每层额外伤害仍大于零，目标仍会受到更多毁灭阴影技能伤害，符合该词条的技能易伤定义。

rows.quote: Applies a stacking %movement_speed_debuff%%% movement speed debuff on enemies hit.
rows.reason_zh: 魔晶仍对命中的敌人施加可叠加的移动减速。

rows.quote: Night Stalker horrifies all nearby enemies, causing them to become silenced and take damage over time while near him.
rows.reason_zh: 施放一次仍可持续伤害附近的所有敌人。

rows.quote: all nearby enemies, causing them to become silenced and take damage over time while near him
rows.reason_zh: 效果仍以暗夜魔王为中心，敌人在他附近时持续受影响。

rows.quote: causing them to become silenced
rows.reason_zh: 说明仍明确对附近敌人施加沉默。

rows.quote: bonus_attack_speed_night.scepter: [50]→[70]
rows.reason_zh: 此次只调整A杖夜间攻速，IsBreakable 字段没有变更，原基础判定沿用。

rows.quote: Killing an enemy hero resets all basic ability cooldowns.
rows.reason_zh: 持有A杖时，击杀敌方英雄仍会刷新所有基础技能的冷却。

rows.quote: Night Stalker is in his element at night, attacking and moving with great swiftness.
rows.reason_zh: 基础技能仍在夜间提高自身移速，此次调整的是A杖攻速。
此次只调整生命回复数值，IsBreakable 字段没有变更，原可被破坏判定沿用。

rows.quote: Night Stalker heals himself when attacking enemy units.
rows.reason_zh: 攻击敌方单位仍会为暗夜魔王恢复生命。

rows.quote: Night Stalker heals himself when attacking enemy units.
rows.reason_zh: 每次攻击敌人触发自身生命回复，仍符合题定的攻击吸血定义。

rows.quote: At night, the ability can be activated to instantly destroy a non-ancient creep and restore a percentage of Night Stalker's maximum health and mana.
rows.reason_zh: 夜间主动消灭非远古普通单位时，仍会按自身最大法力值的一定比例回蓝。

rows.quote: bonus_max_mana_percentage.base: [3]→null；bonus_mana.base: null→[60]
rows.reason_zh: 改动将百分比法力上限加成换成固定法力加成，未涉及原行所指的法力回复。

rows.quote: Dispel Type: Basic Dispel
rows.reason_zh: 装备说明仍明确将施加的驱散标为弱驱散。

rows.quote: Continuously dispels and slows the target, and the target is less susceptible to forced movement effects applied by their allies.
rows.reason_zh: 新增效果降低友军强制位移对目标的作用，未禁止目标使用物品。

rows.quote: Continuously dispels and slows the target
rows.reason_zh: 虽然旧减速间隔时长字段已删除，7.42说明仍明确对目标持续施加减速。

rows.quote: Impale's cooldown is decreased.
rows.reason_zh: 钻地仍会缩短另一技能穿刺的冷却。

rows.quote: Nyx Assassin gains damage reduction from all damage sources
rows.reason_zh: 钻地期间仍可减少来自所有来源的伤害，此次未改动原行的A杖条件。

rows.quote: While burrowed, Nyx Assassin is stationary, unable to attack, and invisible.
rows.reason_zh: 钻地状态仍明确赋予司夜刺客隐身。

rows.quote: mana_regen_rate.base: [1]→null
rows.reason_zh: 钻地自身的基础回蓝率字段已删除，新说明仅写明强化 Scarab Metabolism，未写明该强化提供回蓝。

rows.quote: Once burrowed, Spiked Carapace instantly stuns nearby enemies when cast
rows.reason_zh: 眩晕仍须在钻地后另行施放尖刺外壳，施放钻地本身不会触发眩晕。

rows.quote: Rock spikes burst from the earth along a straight path. Enemy units take damage, then are hurled into the air and stunned.
rows.reason_zh: 一次施放仍可对直线路径上的多个敌方单位造成伤害。

rows.quote: Rock spikes burst from the earth along a straight path.
rows.reason_zh: 伤害和控制仍由施放穿刺产生，未附加到普通攻击上。
各级眩晕时长仍大于零，前三个等级的持续时间有所延长。
各级烧蓝比例均提高，技能仍会削减目标法力。

rows.quote: Deals damage equal to a percentage of the target's Max Mana and burns part of it away.
rows.reason_zh: 技能仍对选定目标造成伤害并烧蓝，移除累计伤害结算未改变原有指向方式。

rows.quote: Adds extra pure damage to Outworld Destroyer's attacks, based on his remaining mana pool.
rows.reason_zh: 普通攻击仍按剩余法力附带额外纯粹伤害，各级伤害系数均大于零。

rows.quote: mana_pool_damage_pct.base: [10,11,12,13]→[9,10,11,12]
rows.reason_zh: 唯一改动是剩余法力转化为伤害的比例，原单体指向判定沿用。

rows.quote: When that happens, Outworld Destroyer receives a strong dispel and gains an undispellable instance of Objurgation.
rows.reason_zh: A杖效果在伤害触及生命阈值时仍会对自身施加强驱散。

rows.quote: mana_to_barrier.base: [12]→[9,10,11,12]
rows.reason_zh: 变更字段涉及护盾的伤害覆盖和换算系数，IsBreakable 字段没有变更，原判定沿用。

rows.quote: When cast, protects Outworld Destroyer with an all damage barrier equal to a flat amount and a percentage of his maximum mana.
rows.reason_zh: 基础技能仍以固定数值和最大法力的一定比例提供全伤害护盾。

rows.quote: Unleashes a psychic blast that deals damage to enemies based on the difference between your max mana and the target's max mana.
rows.reason_zh: 基础伤害和法力差系数均降低，但一次爆发仍可伤害多个敌人。

rows.quote: bonus_cooldown.base: [25]→[20]
rows.reason_zh: 装备冷却缩减数值降至20，仍保有减冷却效果。

rows.quote: bonus_cooldown.base: [25]→[20]
rows.reason_zh: 唯一改动是冷却缩减数值，未涉及原行所指的法力回复属性。
